verdict.rationale: Docs mention running agents step-by-step (useful for tool calls that take days) and step callbacks to modify agent memory dynamically, which could theoretically support pausing and injecting human input, but there is no explicit documented API or workflow for pausing mid-run to request human approval and resuming with that decision. missing for 10: explicit human-in-the-loop approval API, documented pause/resume with human decision injection, hands-on example of this workflow.
